description: The Yard Gym is a boutique strength and conditioning franchise founded in Australia in 2020 by Dan and Tiarne Bova, operated in the US by franchisor TYG Enterprises, LLC, a Delaware LLC formed in 2023. The concept centers on pre-recorded 50-minute instructor-led group classes — RIG strength/endurance, TURF cardio intervals, and Saturday PAY DAY team sessions — run in compact 2,000-4,400 sq ft studios with floor coaches giving individual guidance. Per the 2025 US FDD (issued December 8, 2025), the franchise fee is $50,000, total initial investment ranges from $398,550 to $954,100, royalty is the greater of 7% of gross revenue or $1,600/month, and the marketing fee is the greater of 2% or $200/month. The US system had 9 operating gyms at mid-2025 with 55 additional signed agreements; Item 19 reports average gross revenue of $739,496 across the 2 San Diego gyms open a full year. Risk score 34/100.
territoryDescription: Protected non-exclusive territory: never smaller than a single ZIP code; the franchisor will not grant another Network Gym inside it, but reserves rights for nontraditional venues (malls, airports, stadiums, hotels, military bases, universities, hospitals) and chain acquisitions; territorial rights cover gym placement, not clients.
